event.description: Tie the two depth applications to one shared d16 h2 ff48 block
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none (baseline is the starting incumbent); same-family failed result: none; prior attempts in this family: 0. Hypothesis: reusing one block twice preserves two causal self-attention applications while removing duplicate block parameters, testing parameterization-preserving compression. This is more informative than the nearest untested one-layer deletion because it isolates whether repeated depth computation is useful without removing the second attention application. Candidate uses tie_layers=True, otherwise unchanged; retain only if official accuracy is at least 99% and strictly below 6080 parameters.
